setup.heading: Set up game
setup.teamModeHint: Players can be grouped into teams whose points count together.
setup.teamScoringSharedHint: Team members jointly enter one combined score per round.
setup.teamScoringIndividualHint: Each player enters their own score — both individual scores and the team total are shown.
setup.allowNegativeHint: When off, negative round entries are clamped to 0.
setup.targetBonusHint: Extra points the winner(s) get for reaching the target score (0 = no bonus).

fixedRoundsSetup.title: Points round with fixed round count — New game

fixedRoundsGame.title: Points round with fixed round count

pointsToTarget.title: Points to target
pointsToTarget.description: Points are added up round by round until someone reaches or exceeds a fixed target value. Whoever has the most points then wins.

pointsOpen.title: Open point round
pointsOpen.description: Points are added up round by round with no fixed target. You decide yourselves when to stop — highest or lowest score wins, as you set it up.

fixedRounds.title: Points round with fixed round count
fixedRounds.description: You decide during setup how many rounds to play and whether the highest or lowest score wins at the end. After the last round, the game asks whether to finish or extend by more rounds.

rage.title: RAGE
rage.description: Fixed 10 rounds with a decreasing number of cards (10 down to 1). Before each round you bid your trick count, then enter the actual tricks — points are calculated automatically according to the RAGE rules (incl. Rage bonus/revenge).

newGame.heading: Start a new game
newGame.hint: Choose a scoring mode for your game.

pwaHint.heading: Use as an app
pwaHint.text: On iPad/iPhone: tap the Share icon in Safari, then choose “Add to Home Screen” — the page will then appear like its own app, without the address bar.

support.label: Support this project
support.ariaLabel: Support this project on Buy Me a Coffee

players.heading: Manage players

active.heading: Active players
active.hint: These players are available for quick selection in new games.

inactive.heading: Deactivated players
inactive.hint: Stay visible in past games but no longer appear in quick selection.

players.deleteConfirm: Really permanently delete "{name}"? Unlike removing, there is no way back in player management — past games will still show the name.

groups.hint: Group players together (e.g. "Family", "Regulars") — when setting up a game, you can then select the whole group with one click. A person can be in multiple groups.
groups.deleteConfirm: Really delete group "{name}"? The members themselves stay — only the grouping is removed.

filter.heading: Time range
filter.hint: Leave empty for stats across all games. For a game night that crosses midnight, e.g. enter 18:00 to 03:00 the next day.

overall.heading: Overall
overall.empty: No games in this time range.

modeDistribution.heading: Mode distribution
modeDistribution.empty: No games in this time range.

headToHead.heading: Head to head
headToHead.empty: No two players with shared finished games in this time range yet.

games.heading: Games in this time range
games.empty: No games in this time range.

avatarCropper.heading: Choose image crop
avatarCropper.hint: Drag to pan, use the slider to zoom (passport-photo format 2:3).

history.heading: Game history

all.heading: All games
all.hint: Newest first. Ongoing games can be resumed, finished ones show the result.

history.deleteConfirm: Really permanently delete "{label}" from game history?

settings.heading: Settings
settings.subtitle: Applies to everyone using this app (stored globally).

theme.heading: Appearance
theme.hint: Three independent looks to choose from. Fine-tuning of the colors can be found further below under "Colors in detail".

title.heading: Title
title.hint: Shown in the header and in the browser tab title.
title.label: Title

feedback.heading: Feedback on save
feedback.hint: Short sound (and vibration, where supported by the device) when saving a round. On iPhone/iPad vibration isn't possible for technical reasons (Safari), but the sound works.
feedback.label: Sound on save

roundEntry.heading: Round entry
roundEntry.hint: Step buttons as an alternative to typing numbers when entering rounds (Points to target, Open point round, Fixed round count). Switch between typing and step buttons anytime, even mid-game.

access.heading: Access protection
access.hint: Protects the whole site with one shared password for everyone who knows the link. Without active protection, anyone with the link can use the site.
access.noPasswordSet: No password is set yet — protection stays inactive until one is set.
access.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Leave blank to keep the currently saved password. Forgot the password? See the README for the file-access reset instructions.
access.tooShortError: The password must be at least 8 characters long.

logo.heading: Logo
logo.hint: No custom logo is active by default, the pen icon stays visible.
logo.squareHint: Recommended: 160×160 pixels (square). PNG, JPEG, or SVG, max. 2 MB.
logo.bannerHint: Recommended: approx. 1400×160 pixels (wide, not too tall). PNG, JPEG, or SVG, max. 2 MB.

language.heading: Language
language.hint: More languages can be added later.
language.label: Language

colors.boldNote: Only applies to Classic — Bold uses the presets above.

single.heading: Accent and function colors
single.hint: Apply unchanged in light and dark mode.

pairs.heading: Base colors (separate for light/dark mode)
pairs.hint: Background, surface, text, and border — once each for light and dark mode.

flip.heading: Flip Board colors
flip.hint: Overrides the color suggestion selected above — once each for light and dark mode.

settings.resetConfirm: Really reset all colors to their default values?
settings.savedStatus: Saved. Other pages will pick up the change on their next visit.

backup.heading: Data backup
backup.hint: Full backup of all players, games, avatars and logos as a ZIP file — e.g. to make sure nothing is lost when moving to a new server.
backup.exportHint: Contains the complete database plus all avatar images and the logo.
backup.importWarning: Warning: an import irreversibly replaces all current players, games, avatars and logos with the contents of the backup file.
backup.confirmHint: To confirm, type ERSETZEN exactly as shown below.
backup.noFileSelected: Please select a backup file first.
backup.finalConfirm: Really replace all current game data irreversibly with the backup?
backup.importSuccess: Backup restored: {games} games, {players} players. Reloading page …

setup.winDirectionHint: In most games the highest score wins (e.g. Flip7, Tutto) — but in some, like Skyjo, the lowest score wins instead. The game still ends as soon as anyone reaches or exceeds the target.
